invocations.sensitive_value_handling: The generated disposable PostgreSQL password and connection URL were used only in process memory and were not persisted in evidence.

environment.description: A newly created PostgreSQL 17 Alpine container replayed the complete migration chain and executed twelve locked E11 scale/topology scenarios; one local shared identity-api runtime artifact was built for all scenarios.
environment.isolation: Disposable Docker container zhudatuan-e11-59a3f187ae344aba; synthetic E11 nodes only; each scenario rolled back and the container was removed after execution.
environment.production_impact: None. No production service, database, DNS provider, payment provider, supplier or customer record was contacted.
differences_from_production: Local disposable Docker PostgreSQL rather than managed Alibaba Cloud PostgreSQL.
Synthetic Hosted and sovereign-control nodes rather than customer traffic.
Local build provenance and operation observation rather than production deployment or cloud audit logs.
No stable staging environment identity and no production observation.

artifacts.role: Locked four-scale by three-topology input descriptors and sovereign controls
Per-scale business-source inventories and one actual shared runtime build provenance
Hosted database operations and empty per-node infrastructure event ledger
Raw per-node provisioning, context, scope, capability and latency observations
Database cardinality, closure, line isolation, duplicate and rollback recounts
Independent source/build/event/resolution recount and negative mutation probes
Exact commands, source SHA, execution totals and cleanup record

independent_oracle.procedure: Independently recount source inventory entries and digests at every scale, actual build invocations and artifact identities, Hosted per-node infrastructure events, scenario and topology completeness, per-node context/scope/capability outputs, sovereign controls, isolation aggregates and latency sample presence. Mutate copies to prove detection of generated node source, build/event growth and cross-line resolution; do not consume runner PASS fields.

evaluator.relationship_to_test_item: Implemented the E11 fixture orchestration and evidence exporter, executed the disposable database and shared build, and operated the separate raw-evidence oracle; not an independent reviewer.

prerequisites: clean checkout of the recorded source SHA
steps: Read scale-independent-recount.json and independently verify the listed artifact hashes.
expected_raw_observations: business source file count delta from 1 to 1000 nodes = 0
Hosted per-node infrastructure action total and scale delta = 0
context, scope, capability and sovereign control mismatch count = 0
duplicate node and cross-line closure/scope row count = 0
missing or malformed latency sample count = 0
reproduction.cleanup: The runner rolls back every scenario, removes the disposable PostgreSQL container in a finally block, and deletes its temporary shared build output.

assessment.rationale: All twelve scale/topology scenarios were complete; source count and digest stayed constant, one shared artifact identity served all scenarios, Hosted per-node infrastructure events remained zero, and every generated/control node reconciled without duplicate or cross-line rows. All three negative oracle mutations were detected.
gaps: No stable separately managed staging replay has been performed.
No authorized production infrastructure audit-log observation has been performed.
No reviewer independent of the E11 generator, counting code and execution has recomputed and signed the evidence.
